name: Rudrabhishek
description: Panchamrit abhishek of the Shiva lingam with milk, curd, honey, ghee, and sugar, followed by Bilva patra offering and Rudrashtakam recitation.

name: Satyanarayan Katha
description: The complete recitation of Shri Satyanarayan Vrat Katha by a qualified pandit. Performed for new beginnings, housewarmings, and fulfillment of desires.

name: Ganesh Puja
description: Shodashopachar puja of Lord Ganesha. Performed before any new beginning — travel, business, marriage, or any important undertaking.

name: Lakshmi Puja
description: Mahalakshmi puja for prosperity, wealth, and abundance. Performed with lotus flowers, saffron, and Shri Sukta recitation.

name: Durga Saptashati Patha
description: Complete recitation of all 700 verses of Durga Saptashati (Devi Mahatmya) by a qualified pandit. Most powerful on Navratri days.

name: Pind Daan & Tarpan
description: Complete pind daan and tarpan ceremony on the banks of the Ganga at Varanasi or Gaya. Performed for the liberation of ancestors.

name: Hanuman Puja & Sundarkand
description: Complete Sundarkand path followed by Hanuman puja with sindoor, red flowers, and sesame oil. Most effective on Tuesdays and Saturdays.

name: Navgrah Shanti Puja
description: Puja and homa for the pacification of all nine planetary energies. Recommended for those facing career difficulties, health issues, or astrological doshas.

name: Vivah Saptapadi Puja
description: Complete traditional Hindu wedding ceremony with seven sacred steps around the sacred fire. Full Vedic vidhi conducted by a qualified Vedic pandit.

name: Griha Pravesh Puja
description: Vastu puja and housewarming ceremony for a new home. Ensures positive energy, Vastu balance, and divine blessings for all inhabitants.
